title: Custom AST Validation Parser
pattern: Representing simple validation logic as a custom-parsed grammar tree evaluated at runtime.
why_bad: It requires maintaining a complex parser stack. It slows validation, complicates basic error messaging, and lacks compile-time verification.
detection: Custom tokenizers and AST validation structures within standard helper libraries.
counterexample: `Context-dependent`. General-purpose forms engines where validation logic is configured dynamically by non-programming users via UI schemas.
source: Joshua Kerievsky - _Refactoring to Patterns_ (2004, Addison-Wesley Professional).pdf, Chapter 7 "Replace Implicit Language with Interpreter".
